prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1331; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center with the left tail lamp housing broken, and the trunk lid shows a crease consistent with the reported rear impact. The damage pattern lines up well with how the collision was described. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and tail lamp assembly, repairing the trunk lid, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage, and the parts and charges on the invoices show no repeated entries. Nothing in the file suggests earlier damage to this vehicle in these areas.
